snapshot.title: Unauthorized PLC-02 Logic Access Attempt

lines.msg: Session from 10.72.20.12 (MBW-CIS-01) to 10.72.30.44 (MBW-JUMP-01) via FW-R-17. User: Kessler-Remote-01. Source: 10.72.20.15 (Jared Molina’s Kessler Controls laptop). Password: K3ssler#2025.
Attempted write to PLC-02 program file (PLC-02-LOGIC-2025.bin). Copy not in backup.
Only current copy of the updated logic exists in PLC-02. No copy in MBW-BKP-01.
Session terminated by host auto-kill (09:09:15). No ticket in MBW-JUMP-01 audit log.
User Kessler-Remote-01 not listed in approved vendor access window (Section 6.2). No authorization for remote session.
Unapproved session from Kessler Controls laptop (10.72.20.15) to jump host. Attempted modification of SCADA PLC program.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the unauthorized remote session from a Kessler Controls laptop using a default password. The session attempted to write to the PLC-02 logic file, which is not backed up. IT must report this to the Incident Commander and FBI liaison immediately.
